## When to use it

Diagnose and revise prose with staccato runs, uniform sentence lengths, repeated openings, mechanical clause structures, repeated contrast formulas, or abstract process framing that hides the actor and delays the real comparison. Use for requests about cadence, rhythm, meter, sentence variety, choppy prose, monotonous prose, or patterns such as "not X but Y" and "treats X as Y, not Z."

Example request:

> Use writing-cadence to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill writing-cadence
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/writing-cadence/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/writing-cadence/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
